title: Teams and Linear: exact task-linked reviews and single-attempt actions
goal: Distinguish target reads/local preparation, exact genuine independent approval, requester execution once and original-record recovery without treating saved receipts or mocks as current provider access.
prerequisites: Internal source-only local-preview authoring record. Current installed support, activation, actual connection health and provider access are unverified and must be checked separately.

Current verified desktop workspace/session, consenting provider owner, accepted provider/target access and current saved task version where task-linked. Slack/Outlook reviews do not authorize Teams/Linear.

Teams channel APIs require an eligible work/school account and appropriate Microsoft licensing/access; personal Teams and passing mocks are not proof of those prerequisites. The fixed target reader classifies only its exact recognized403license denial and does not change subscriptions or retry.
permissions: connections:manage is required for permission setup and requester execution, with current role/session/owner/workspace checks; server capability remains decisive.
agent:approve records a genuine independent human decision for the exact plan, not execution permission. Requester is executor, reviewer must be a different eligible person.
Consent, target access, provider activation, exact approval and execution authority are separate. Disabled-execution notice reflects returned state; runtime flags were not read or changed.

steps.instruction: In Apps & skills open Actions for connected Teams or Linear. For task-linked work, open the selected saved task while clean/unlocked; wait for history to load.
steps.expectedState: ConnectedActionsPanel is shared; BotConnectedActionsPanel delegates the same controls. Outside a task, Task-linked reviews selects linked history; ordinary history excludes it. History shows at most20records and may be truncated.

steps.instruction: Inspect current saved task ID/version and workspace. A historical version warning requires a new action for the current saved version, not reuse of stale authority.
steps.expectedState: Task/version binding is checked by the server; opening history is not a provider mutation or fresh health check.

steps.instruction: Use Review action permissions ↗ only with current desktop session, owner/admin role and connections:manage. Browser action access must match expected user/workspace.
steps.expectedState: Opening a page is not consent. Teams scopes are openid, offline_access, User.Read, Team.ReadBasic.All, Channel.ReadBasic.All, ChannelMessage.Send; Linear requests read/write. Legacy issue-create does not grant update/close.

steps.instruction: Load authorized targets, then select Team from its verified snapshot. For Teams choose a standard Channel and Message; archived teams and nonstandard channels are disabled.
steps.expectedState: Bounded targets are not a complete directory. Message intent maximum4000bytes; current messaging permission and provider target access remain required.

steps.instruction: For Linear create choose Team, Issue title and optional Description; update also selects Issue; close selects Team, Issue and Completed state.
steps.expectedState: Title maximum240bytes, description16000bytes. Update/close require update permission; only completed states are offered for close. Local fields are not provider writes.

steps.instruction: Save exact action for review when available after inspecting exact target/content.
steps.expectedState: Server re-reads authorized targets and requires consenting owner; stores provider, connection revision, workspace/team, exact fields, target evidence and optional task/version with15minute expiry. No provider write; connected alone does not enable execution.

steps.instruction: Inspect saved state, attempt count /1, target IDs, title/content or completed-state ID, digest, expiry, task version and recorded approver. Personally check I reviewed this exact target and content only after inspecting them.
steps.expectedState: Checkbox is local acknowledgement and clears after successful requests; it is not approval.

steps.instruction: A distinct authorized human uses Approve exact action only when agent:approve, requested/unexpired state and current task binding permit.
steps.expectedState: Records approval of this exact plan only. Reviewer differs from requester/executor; AI and this article cannot supply genuine human approval.

steps.instruction: The requester/executor uses Execute approved action once only when current connections:manage, enabled provider, approved/unexpired plan and current task allow.
steps.expectedState: Server current authority, connection/target freshness and outbound guards decide acceptance. One dispatch attempt; recorded verified result may expose Open verified provider result, specific to that operation only.

steps.instruction: Requester may Cancel action while requested/approved. Executor may Reconcile expired attempt while dispatching.
steps.expectedState: Cancel is predispatch review cancellation, not provider undo. Before lease expiry reconciliation returns current record; after expiry records unknown without resend or rollback.

steps.instruction: For pending mutation use Recover same saved action (Reload history). Retry saving same draft, when available for pending creation, preserves original intent.
steps.expectedState: Pending work blocks mutations. Draft retry is not provider execution retry. Unknown requires checking the provider before any new action and says this action will not be resent.

expectedOutcome: Identify exact current plan/task/version and its stored attempt/outcome, using original-record reconciliation and provider inspection rather than repeating an uncertain operation.
limitations: Customer eligible:false. Publication approved:false. Editorial accepted:false. Media accepted:false. Native accepted:false. Release accepted:false. Shipped accepted:false. Human review fields null, media empty; no authentic media or current native/provider acceptance claimed.

proposed. identifiers are authoring candidates only, not installed runtime/help bindings. No ingestion, retrieval activation, customer-approved content, authority, UI or backend capability is created.

The preserved guide/manifest/report retain historical0915135d provenance. Current4f8c94e1 article hashes bind all11unchanged code files plus guide/manifest/report and two explicit work-account/license source references without rewriting history.

Source hashes prove identity only, not semantic accuracy, complete control inventory, current target availability, provider health, actual access or shipped support. Mock/synthetic acceptance is separate from real Teams work-account/licensing gates.
A verified receipt concerns that specific operation, not unrelated delivery or present provider health. Client abort, Close or workspace change does not prove submitted work was undone.
This finite Teams/Linear article excludes Slack/Outlook distinct controls; no automatic resend. Fixture is proposed-not-executed prose, not a completed retrieval/model evaluation.
recovery: Reconcile the original saved state before considering another action. Unknown is neither success nor failure; check provider outcome before any deliberate new action and do not resend the original attempt.
Recover same saved action preserves original intent; Retry saving same draft is only pending creation and does not retry provider execution. Pending work blocks new mutations.
Stale task version, changed workspace/connection/target or lost authority requires current checks; never adopt old approval as authority for edited content/another target/task.

Teams license-required or unavailable target reads are not permission to bypass access, reinterpret mocks as live success, switch accounts silently, retry the denial or purchase/change licensing. Resolve legitimate access with the organization separately.
Cancel cannot undo submitted provider work. Reconcile expired attempt preserves current dispatch until lease expiry then unknown, without resend/undo.
